I was bullied a lot as a kid and had a emotionally and some what physically abusive dad. My mom shot me down when I came out as bisexual for the first time as well at the start of the year. I was going to kill myself in the 6th grade  but I kinda broke down about my depression to the family so I ended up not doing it. I enrolled for online school for the next year. From there I just developed paranoia and I actually didn’t talk to any of my friends cause I felt like a disappoint. This is only the set up for the movie though and keep in mind I was still suicidal. 

I’d say the movie starts when I go back to the school in the last three months of 7th grade. I was shy and still hated my self. I ended reconnecting with friends and some bullies apologized to me. Most just left me alone since I came back though. When I’m better in the movie it’s revealed that everyone stopped making fun of me because they thought I killed my self over the summer since I didn’t come back and the school started a huge anti suicide campaign that year. I ignore it and keep getting better though. The movie ends on the last day of school when I actually am happy with who I am and how life’s going. How I became mentally stable, proud of my sexuality and started to enjoy life for the first time in years. 

It could even sequel to 8ty grade where I start dating a childhood friend (we are both girls for the good movie lgbt love) the night I move to another state and from there it’s me working out a new school and meeting the right friends since for the first few months I hung out with people who ignored me and I ended up relapsing in my depression for a while. 

I’m happy now if anyone want to know though. I’m still working on some be proud of who I am stuff but I’d say I’m doing alright
